summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study is testing 177Lu-FAP-2286, a targeted radionuclide therapy that binds to fibroblast activation protein (FAP), in patients with advanced solid tumors. Phase 2 includes pancreatic, non-small cell lung, and breast cancers. Patients must first have a 68Ga-FAP-2286 PET scan showing FAP uptake, then receive 177Lu-FAP-2286 by IV every 6 weeks for up to 6 doses in Phase 1, or every 4 weeks in Phase 2 monotherapy, with doses of 3.7 to 9.25 GBq (100 to 250 mCi). The study measures safety and tolerability and establishes the recommended Phase 2 dose in Phase 1, and measures safety and efficacy in Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa 177Lu-FAP-2286, una terapia radionuclídica dirigida que se une a la proteína de activación de fibroblastos (FAP), en pacientes con tumores sólidos avanzados. La fase 2 incluye cáncer de páncreas, cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas y cáncer de mama. Los pacientes primero deben tener una tomografía PET con 68Ga-FAP-2286 que muestre captación de FAP, y luego reciben 177Lu-FAP-2286 por vía intravenosa cada 6 semanas, hasta 6 dosis en la fase 1, o cada 4 semanas en la monoterapia de la fase 2, con dosis de 3.7 a 9.25 GBq (100 a 250 mCi). El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad y establece la dosis recomendada para fase 2 en la fase 1, y mide la seguridad y la eficacia en la fase 2.
who_for: Life expectancy of 6 months or more.
Adequate blood, liver, and kidney function laboratory values; Phase 2 also requires specific prior treatment history by cancer group.
not_for: Active cancer other than the one under study, with limited exceptions stated in the record.
Symptomatic or untreated brain or CNS metastases, or leptomeningeal disease.
Pancreatic endocrine or neuroendocrine tumors (Phase 2 pancreatic groups).
Prior taxane therapy in the Phase 2 lung combination group.
Phase 1 requires tumor that is refractory or has progressed after prior treatment with no satisfactory alternatives.
